source_files: https://github.com/showlab/EgoVLP README (printed row of egoclip.csv, derived from narration_pass_1)
access_used: public sample in paper/repo/card only (full data needs the Ego4D License Agreement)
note: narrations.json is only distributed after signing the Ego4D licence, so no file was downloaded. The examples are narration records printed verbatim in the official guidelines, the official Ego4D notebook, and two public repos that re-package narration_pass_1 (EgoVLP egoclip.csv, Paxion ActionBench). Each narration is one timestamp (not an interval) plus a sentence tagged #C (camera wearer) or #O (someone else); EgoVLP adds a short clip window around the timestamp. Videos are licence-only, so no clip.

Ego4D annotation guidelines examples: #summary C fixed their breakfast, ate it, then got dressed and left the house.

Ego4D annotation guidelines tags.#unsure: to denote they are unsure about a specific statement
Ego4D annotation guidelines tags.#summary: to denote they are giving the overall video
Ego4D annotation guidelines tags.#C: to denote the sentence is an action done by the camera wearer (the person who recorded the video while wearing a camera on their head)
Ego4D annotation guidelines tags.#O: to denote that the sentence is an action done by someone other than the camera wearer
